description: NaGaO₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbca space group. There are two inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O²⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.36 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to four O²⁻ atoms to form distorted NaO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with eight GaO₄ tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.37 Å. There are two inequivalent Ga³⁺ sites. In the first Ga³⁺ site, Ga³⁺ is bonded to four O²⁻ atoms to form GaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four GaO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Ga-O bond distances ranging from 1.84-1.86 Å. In the second Ga³⁺ site, Ga³⁺ is bonded to four O²⁻ atoms to form GaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four GaO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are three shorter (1.84 Å) and one longer (1.85 Å) Ga-O bond length. There are four inequivalent O²⁻ sites. In the first O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to two equivalent Na¹⁺ and two Ga³⁺ atoms to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂Ga₂ trigonal pyramids. In the second O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na¹⁺ and two equivalent Ga³⁺ atoms. In the third O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na¹⁺ and two Ga³⁺ atoms. In the fourth O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na¹⁺ and two equivalent Ga³⁺ atoms.
